flagged.title: Rump Parliament and the rise of Cromwell 1649-1653
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that a similar number of people died at Wexford as at Drogheda (around 3,500), whereas the true figure was between 1,500 and 2,000, which is a significant factual error regarding a key exam topic.

mark_affecting.quote: and a similar number died at Wexford just the following month

flagged.title: Kenilworth Castle in the Civil War
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims that Leicester's Gatehouse is crumbling and ruined (when it is famously intact as the primary preserved dwelling), and wrongly states that Kenilworth was garrisoned under Sir Edward Peyto (who held Warwick Castle).

mark_affecting.quote: See, it was held firmly for Parliament by a local gentleman named Sir Edward Peyto.
And you'll see the crumbling state of Leicester's Gatehouse and the Great Hall.
